name: FastMCP GRC Corpus
description: FastMCP server exposing the GRC corpus as MCP tools over stdio. Read-only access to docs/grc/ including POA&M and SSP excerpts. Low sensitivity because the served corpus is sanitized and the transport is local stdio with no network surface.

skills.name: GRC Doc Search
skills.description: Searches the GRC corpus by natural language query and returns matching document paths and excerpts.

skills.name: GRC Doc Read
skills.description: Returns the full body of a named GRC document keyed by path under docs/grc/.

skills.name: POA&M Query
skills.description: Looks up a POA&M item by id and returns its current state, owner, and citations.

skills.name: SSP Query
skills.description: Returns the SSP section that owns a given NIST control or control family.

skills.name: Framework Lookup
skills.description: Resolves a NIST 800-53 family or FedRAMP baseline against the crosswalk and returns the mapped controls.
